name: Short-Form ASR Collapse — Clean (Calibration)
description: Calibration recipe for the S01 short-form clean ASR family. Takes a directory of .wav files (+ optional ground-truth .txt transcripts). Stage 1 runs Whisper to transcribe each file and assigns a 3-class confidence label (clear/ambiguous/noisy) from segment-level avg_logprob; it also writes .txt transcript files into the audio-corpus dir so Stage 2 can embed them. Stage 3 trains a MiniLM-MLP student (topic-map task) on the confidence labels, producing an ONNX head that routes audio-derived transcripts through the ASR adaptive ladder (fragment-only → early-exit → escalation). Whisper model defaults to 'base' — override with WHISPER_MODEL env var.
